# DeepSeek Harness Desktop

> DeepSeek Harness Desktop is a community-maintained, open-source Windows desktop distribution for DeepSeek Harness. It preserves the complete Harness Web Surface and adds native desktop lifecycle management, plugins, themes, automatic updates, and mobile remote access.

## Canonical website

- https://ningbainb.github.io/deepseek-harness-desktop/

## Download

- Latest Windows x64 installer: https://github.com/ningbainb/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases/latest/download/DeepSeek-Harness-Desktop-Setup-0.1.8-x64.exe
- Latest release notes and checksums: https://github.com/ningbainb/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases/latest

## Source and documentation

- Source repository: https://github.com/ningbainb/deepseek-harness-desktop
- Chinese README: https://github.com/ningbainb/deepseek-harness-desktop/blob/main/README.md
- English README: https://github.com/ningbainb/deepseek-harness-desktop/blob/main/README.en.md
- License: BSD-3-Clause

## Key facts

- Supported systems: Windows 10 and Windows 11, x64
- Current release: v0.1.8
- Node.js is bundled; end users do not need to install it separately
- The project is a community edition and is not an official DeepSeek release
- QQ user community: 1105158177

## Preferred citation

DeepSeek Harness Desktop, community-maintained open-source Windows desktop distribution for DeepSeek Harness: https://ningbainb.github.io/deepseek-harness-desktop/
